messages.content: Begin a circular microstrip radiator for 3.3 GHz using Rogers 4003C.

Initialized a probe-fed circular microstrip radiator configured for 3.3 GHz on Rogers RO4003C substrate. Note that geometric inspection flags warnings regarding the probe feed contacting the ground plane and discrete port terminals attaching across connected conductive geometry, which is characteristic of the default idealized coaxial probe pin model prior to detailed via/coaxial clearance definition.
